title: Money & Banking · Money and the state

concepts.title: A bond purchase can transfer existing deposits; a bank loan can create a new deposit.
A withdrawal of gold reduces bank reserves without extinguishing the government’s loan.
Greenbacks and national banknotes have different issuers and backing.
Seasonal cash withdrawals can propagate through reserve deposits and call loans.
Rediscounting exchanges eligible paper for newly issued reserve balances.
Converting reserves into notes changes the form of central-bank liabilities.
The central bank serves banks and the government; their financing needs can reshape its operations.
An outright securities purchase creates reserve balances; a secured advance also creates a bank debt.
